svg.title: Captured Aspire trace: all 22 spans
svg.desc: Vector redraw of the saved Aspire screenshot. The 22 displayed spans show their names, resources and parent relationships, with circular bar markers. Original displayed durations are retained in metadata. Bar shapes are traced from screenshot pixels, not reconstructed start/end timestamps. The runbook service is shaded amber.
